name: channel-copy
description: Telegram old channel ke audio/video ko new channel me copy karta hai (worker dyno).

SESSION_STRING.description: generate_session.py ko apne PC par chala ke mili lambi string. Kisi ko mat dena.

NEW_CHANNEL.description: Naye channel ka id (jaise -1002222222222). Aap usme admin hone chahiye.

BATCH.description: Ek baar me kitne copy karne hain (max 100).

DELAY.description: Har batch ke baad kitne seconds rukna hai (kam mat karo, ban ka darr).

BOT_TOKEN.description: Optional: phone par notification ke liye bot token (@BotFather).

NOTIFY_USER_ID.description: Optional: aapka Telegram user id (@userinfobot), bot se notification ke liye.
